pipeline: ML Kit Latin + PP-OCRv6 Medium det+rec (parallel, fused) -> GLiNER-Small INT4 -> existing Lab v7 post-processing

model.notes: INT4 weight-only quantization keeps float32 activations. The graph must contain MatMulNBits nodes; the app reports whether it does before a run.

io_contract.prompt: ent_token, label, ent_token, label, ent_token, label, sep_token + label words
io_contract.words_mask: 1-based word index on the first subtoken of each text word, 0 on prompt and continuation subtokens
io_contract.spans: every (start, end) word span with end-start+1 <= max_width, shorter spans first

readings.start: both engines read the same decoded label, launched together; the app-wide NativeEngineGate serialises the native calls
readings.fusion: one line when the normalized texts match at (almost) the same place, or when boxes overlap strongly and the spellings are close; every other reading is kept for GLiNER
readings.engine_scores: each fused line keeps every engine that read it with that engine's own measured score; lane records emit one TokenRecord per engine
readings.rejected: nothing is dropped for low confidence in stage 1; low-confidence fragments are evidence for the contextual stage

provisioning.device_time: Settings > Scanner testing > GLiNER lane lab > Import model files (ONNX + tokenizer.json + gliner_config.json)

validation: Models are not shipped in this repository. The lab refuses to run an unpinned, missing or non-INT4 graph and reports exactly which file failed.
